mutants.name: machine-dropped-from-key
mutants.why: notify_watcher_down must include the watched machine in the detail key so two machines stale at once each page independently; dropping the machine reverts the key to status-only and the second machine's page is swallowed by the first's dedupe entry

mutants.name: live-row-clears-all-machines
mutants.why: mark_machine_live must only clear the named machine's dedupe key; clearing all watcher_down keys means a live machine's poll row re-arms every stale machine's dedupe and the stale machine pages on every poll instead of once per episode

mutants.name: live-row-clears-nothing
mutants.why: mark_machine_live must remove the matched key from _dedupe_memo so a new stale episode pages once; replacing pop with get reads the value but leaves the entry intact and the second episode is silently eaten
